main_text.l: עַל Super, Supra: Contra, Adversus: Coram: Propter, Eò quòd: Ad, Apud, Juxta, Secundùm, quomodo pro אֶל fumitur: Cum, pro עִם; ut Exod.35.22. In, Per, pro בְּ, Gen.27.40. Latissimè usurpatur. Semel scriptū עַל & legendū אֶל Ne, Ezech.9.5. עַל־כֵּן Idcirco, Propterea: עַל כִּי Eò quòd, עַל אֲשֶׁר Idè: עַל־דְּבַר Propter. Assumit ad fine, עָלֵי ut & aliae quaedam similes Particulae: ut, עַל אֶרֶץ Juxta femitā, Gen.49.17. Cum Affixis ꞑ habet Kametz, עָלַי Contra me, עָלֶיךָ Contra te, עָלָיו Contra eū, & cat. exceptis Affixis conftructa forma, עֲלֵיכֶם, עֲלֵיהֶם, &c. מֵעַל A, Ab, Defuper, Supernè. Chald. Idē: עַל דְּנָה Super hoc, Propter hoc, Propterea. Cum Affixis, עֲלוֹהִי Contra eum, Super eum, In eo, Ad eum, עָלָךְ Super, Ad te, עֲלֵיהוֹן Ad eos, עֲלַי Ad me, עֲלֵינָא Ad nos, עֲלֵיהוֹן & עֲלֵיהוֹן Ad eos. Semel cum א in fine, וְעַלָּא מִנֵּהוֹן Et supra ab iftis, id est, supra iftos, Dan.6.3.
עֲלָה m. Afcenfus, Gradus, juxta Kimchium, לַעֲלֵה Ad afcenfum oftii portæ, Ezech.40.40. Quibusdam eft Participium, Afcendens.

עָלָה m. Folium, quia Surfum crescit, vel levi flatu furfum propellitur: עֲלֵה כְּמַּגֶּפֶן Folium de vite, Jef.34.4. Conftr. עֲלֵה תְאֵנָה Folium ficus, Gen.3.7. Plur. Conftr. עֲלֵי זַיִת Folia olea, Neh.8.15. Aff. עָלָיו Foliis fuis, Jef.1.30. defectivè pro עָלֶיהָ juxta Maforethas & Hebræos.

עוֹלָה ־ עֹלָה f. Holocauftum, fic dictum, quòd totum igne abfumptum, furfum Afcenderet, & Evanefceret: Item, Afcenfus: Aff. וְעֹלָתוֹ Et adfcenfum ejus, 1.Reg.10.5. עוֹלָתְךָ Holocauftum tuum, Levit.9.7. Plural. עוֹלוֹת Holocaufta, Gen.8.20. Aff. וְעֹלוֹתֶיךָ Et holocaufta tua, Psal.50.8. עֹלוֹתָיו Afcenfuum ejus, Ezech.40.26. Plur.Chald. לְעִלָּוִין In holocaufta, Esr.6.9.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh in the entries are read from a small, slightly blurred scan; the consonants are secure but the pointing of several forms (e.g. עֲלֵיהוֹן, עֲלֵינָא, לְעִלָּוִין, לַעֲלֵה) should be checked against the original. The reference "Ezech.40.40" and "Ezech.40.26" may be misread digits. A small mark ("•") sits at the foot of the page and is not text. The printed "ß" in "Latißimè" is read as long s and given as "Latissimè" in the transcription; the printed form is "Latißimè". The printed "ufurpatur" is given as "usurpatur" under the u/v rule.
